name: writing-governance-records
description: This skill should be used when the user wants to write or update the governance record for one AI workflow: where it stands on each of the eight governance practices (name and description, ownership, process, building blocks, evaluations, SOP, operations, change management), with every gap turned into a follow-up action. Triggers: "write the governance record for my [workflow]", "assess my [workflow] against the governance practices", "where does my workflow stand on governance", "update the governance record for [workflow]". It reads the workflow's registry entry and its files from the AI Workflow Framework first, asks only what they don't answer, and saves the record beside the workflow's other files. Not for the company-wide policy or checking every workflow against it (writing-ai-governance-policies), writing the SOP itself (writing-workflow-sops), or testing the workflow (test).
